The '''Ariarch sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of space located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It included the planet [[Dalron Five|Dalron V]] and the [[Keitum system/Legends|Keitum system]].
